title: Moldavian Campaign (1538)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Moldavian Campaign (1538)", at revision 1374693027, opens: "The Moldavian campaign in 1538 was a military expedition led by the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent against the Moldavian prince Petru Rareș. The campaign was an Ottoman success, and Petru was deposed. The Ottomans also captured Suceava, South Bessarabia, and the northern Black Sea coast." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q6084870, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1538 military expedition led by the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent against the Moldavian prince Petru Rareș".
